# {{ P.name }}

> A private {{ "{:,}".format(P.home.square_feet) }} square foot log chalet in June Lake, California, rented as a whole home to one party. Sleeps {{ P.home.max_overnight_guests }} in three private suites, with an outdoor hydrotherapy tub under Carson Peak. On the June Lake Loop in Mono County, 27 highway miles from Yosemite National Park's Tioga Pass (east) entrance, about 45 minutes from Tuolumne Meadows, and one mile from June Mountain Ski Area.

## At a glance
- Who it suits: families and groups of up to eight who want one house near Yosemite's east side
- Yosemite: 27 miles to the Tioga Pass entrance and about 45 minutes to Tuolumne Meadows, when Tioga Road is open (usually late May or June to about November)
- June Mountain: 1 mile; kids 12 and under ski free there all season
- Season: open all year; the outdoor hot tub runs all year
- Nightly rates: $295 to $995 (Christmas peak at the top). Fees: a flat $295 cleaning fee and Mono County's 15% lodging tax, nothing else

## The property
- Whole-home rental only; individual rooms are not rented
- Up to {{ P.home.max_overnight_guests }} overnight guests including infants; no more than {{ P.home.max_on_property }} people on the property; {{ P.home.max_cars }}-car maximum (Mono County limits)
- Three bedroom suites, each with a private bath, plus a half bath on the main level
- Beds: two California King and one queen memory foam bed, a pull-out couch in the master suite loft, a queen futon in the family room
{% for a in P.amenities %}- {{ a }}
{% endfor %}- No pets. No smoking indoors.
- Check-in {{ P.home.check_in }}. Check-out {{ P.home.check_out }}.
- {{ P.home.tax }} and a {{ P.home.cleaning_fee }} cleaning fee per stay. No other fees.

Tioga Road (Highway 120) over Tioga Pass is seasonal, usually open from late May or June until about November. In winter there is no entrance to Yosemite from the east side.
